title: Linear proof word construction
statement: For a Boolean word $w$ of length $2m$, define a Boolean word of length $2m+1$ by splitting each output position according to the decomposition into a block of length $m$ and a block of length $m+1$. At a position in the first block, use the Boolean value associated with the corresponding pair-bit of $w$; at a position in the second block, use the Boolean value associated with the corresponding prefix-bit of $w$.
caveat: The formal statement uses pair-bit and prefix-bit functions whose definitions are not included in the supplied definitions, so their mathematical meaning cannot be specified further.
